notes.title: Today Stories
notes.text: See what your friends watched, rated and commented on in the last 24 hours. Tap Today on Home and flip through it story by story.

notes.title: Smart Lists
notes.text: Smart lists can now pull from All titles, your Watchlist or your Library, and mix shows and movies in one list.

notes.title: Misc.
notes.text: Checked an episode further ahead? We now offer to mark the skipped ones as watched too and lots of smaller fixes!

notes.title: Media Reactions
notes.text: Show everyone how you really feel! React to movies and shows straight from their summary or right after rating them.

notes.title: Comment Translations
notes.text: Read comments in your own language. Translate them with a single tap, right on your device.

notes.title: Parental Guide
notes.text: Check content advisories in the movie and show info sheets before you press play.
